purpose: Targeted closure pass on the main remaining legal/currentness and fee gaps after the first two substantive passes.

records.result: Current Legesverordening Gooise Meren 2026 is positively confirmed in force from 01-01-2026. The 2026 tariff for a splitsingsvergunning is EUR 1,343.00 per dwelling/apartment/unit with a maximum of EUR 26,947.00. This supersedes the previously displayed 2025 fee of EUR 1,302.00 and maximum EUR 26,124.10. The current Omgevingsplan CVDR696529 is also confirmed current from 25-11-2025 and includes integrated legal components.
remaining: current ordinary room-rental/omzetting framework and its application documents

records.result: Current official electronic-channel decision confirms distinct Omgevingsloket routes for onttrekkingsvergunning for kamerverhuur, withdrawal for merging/business/demolition, woning splitsen and splitsingsvergunning. This is treated as current operational routing. Final targeted search did not positively surface a current generic municipality-wide substantive housing-stock regulation in the searched official index; therefore no obsolete or other-municipality rule is imported.
closed: current application channel per relevant activity
remaining: current substantive housing-stock/Omgevingsplan criteria for kamerverhuur/onttrekking/splitting
activity-specific application documents and 2026 fees/decision period

records.result: Current Omgevingsplan remains the controlling spatial framework. Official municipal/council material confirms room rental is handled through the spatial/omgevingsvergunning route rather than a Huisvestingsverordening permit system, and refers to a 2015 policy for non-self-contained room rental. A fresh official regulation search did not positively establish that 2015 policy as a currently published active regulation or identify a successor. The old policy is therefore kept only as historical/policy-direction evidence; current permission must be checked against the Omgevingsplan and any current BOPA policy.
closed: no separate Huisvestingsverordening kamerverhuur permit system established
remaining: successor/currentness of room-rental assessment policy if later positively published
application package/fees/term for concrete BOPA/OPA route

records.result: Current Huisvestigingsverordening Gorinchem 2024 wijzigingsbesluit is confirmed valid from 08-07-2025 through 14-06-2028 and currently regulates opkoopbescherming in specified areas/conditions. It does not by itself establish the missing ordinary room-rental/splitting framework. Current Bibob policy remains a risk-screening signal for kamerverhuur/omzettingsvergunning branches, not the substantive permission rule. Older 2011 housing regulation is explicitly excluded as current law.
closed: exclusion of obsolete 2011 regulation as current law
remaining: current substantive room-rental/omzetting and structural splitting plan rules
official current application package and exact 2026 fees/term

records.result: Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696521 is positively confirmed in force from 29-07-2025. The generic concept/application route and 8-week framework remain valid. The concept-request amounts displayed on the municipal page remain flagged because the page references 2025 leges; they are not promoted to definitive 2026 fees without current tariff-table proof.
closed: generic application route and decision framework
